recognize_zh: 中期（metaphase）FISH 圖中有兩個分裂中期細胞，每個細胞各在一條染色體上可見緊鄰重疊的紅綠（黃色）融合訊號；表示 PML 與 RARA 序列被併在同一條染色體上，符合隱匿性插入所形成的 PML::RARA 融合。
features: Each metaphase shows one colocalized red-green (yellow) fusion signal on a single chromosome
Fusion signal located within an otherwise normal-appearing chromosome
Separate normal red and green signals are not clearly resolved in this image
describe_en: Metaphase FISH shows two DAPI-counterstained metaphase spreads, each containing a single colocalized red-green fusion signal on one chromosome, without an obvious translocation-derived chromosome. Assuming a PML/RARA probe set, this indicates juxtaposition of PML and RARA sequences, consistent with a cryptic insertion producing PML::RARA in a karyotypically normal or near-normal case. The expected separate normal signals are not clearly visible at this resolution, and chromosome identification requires inverted-DAPI or sequential banding; RT-PCR confirmation of the fusion transcript is recommended.
